# Configuration Templates

> Reference file for the Autional Onboarding skill.
> Fill the `{BRACED}` fields per project; the rest is already region-correct.
<!-- /lang:en -->
<!-- lang:zh -->
# 配置模板参考

> Autional 接入 Skill 的引用文件。
> `{花括号}` 字段按项目填写；其余内容已按 region 填好。
<!-- /lang:zh -->

<!-- lang:en -->
## src/autional.ts (React example)

```ts
/**
 * Autional config — generated by the Autional onboarding procedure
 * Date: {DATE}
 * Framework: {FRAMEWORK}
 */

import { AutionalProvider, useAutional, RequireAuth } from '{{NPM_SCOPE}}/react';

export const autionalConfig = {
  appId: '{APP_ID}',
  issuer: '{{ISSUER}}',
  apiUrl: '{{API_URL}}',
  syncTabs: true,
};

export { AutionalProvider, useAutional, RequireAuth };
```

Vue: `import { createAutional } from '{{NPM_SCOPE}}/vue'` → `app.use(createAutional(autionalConfig))`.
Next.js: wrap the root layout with the provider from `{{NPM_SCOPE}}/next` and protect routes via its middleware export.

## .env (public — safe to commit)

```env
# Autional — public configuration (safe to commit)
AUTIONAL_APP_ID={APP_ID}
AUTIONAL_ISSUER={{ISSUER}}
AUTIONAL_API_URL={{API_URL}}
```

Use the framework's public prefix when needed: `VITE_` (Vite), `NEXT_PUBLIC_` (Next.js), `REACT_APP_` (CRA); none for Node.

## .env.local (private — never commit)

```env
# Autional — private notes (gitignored automatically)
# Created: {DATE}
# Admin email: {ADMIN_EMAIL}
# Admin password: stored separately, NOT in this file
```
<!-- /lang:en -->
<!-- lang:zh -->
## src/autional.ts（React 示例）

```ts
/**
 * Autional 配置 — 由 Autional 接入流程生成
 * 日期: {DATE}
 * 框架: {FRAMEWORK}
 */

import { AutionalProvider, useAutional, RequireAuth } from '{{NPM_SCOPE}}/react';

export const autionalConfig = {
  appId: '{APP_ID}',
  issuer: '{{ISSUER}}',
  apiUrl: '{{API_URL}}',
  syncTabs: true,
};

export { AutionalProvider, useAutional, RequireAuth };
```

Vue：`import { createAutional } from '{{NPM_SCOPE}}/vue'` → `app.use(createAutional(autionalConfig))`。
Next.js：在根 layout 用 `{{NPM_SCOPE}}/next` 的 Provider 包裹，并用其 middleware 保护路由。

## .env（公开——可提交 git）

```env
# Autional — 公开配置（可提交 git）
AUTIONAL_APP_ID={APP_ID}
AUTIONAL_ISSUER={{ISSUER}}
AUTIONAL_API_URL={{API_URL}}
```

按框架使用公开前缀：`VITE_`（Vite）、`NEXT_PUBLIC_`（Next.js）、`REACT_APP_`（CRA）；Node 无需前缀。

## .env.local（私密——绝不提交）

```env
# Autional — 私密备注（已自动 gitignore）
# 创建日期: {DATE}
# 管理员邮箱: {ADMIN_EMAIL}
# 管理员密码: 单独保存，不在此文件
```
<!-- /lang:zh -->

<!-- lang:en -->
## AUTIONAL_SETUP.md template

```markdown
# Autional Integration — {PROJECT_NAME}

## Basics
- Date: {DATE}
- Framework: {FRAMEWORK}
- Tenant: {TENANT_NAME}
- Region: .{{REGION}}
- Environment: {ENVIRONMENT}

## Configuration
- App ID: {APP_ID}
- Issuer: {{ISSUER}}
- API URL: {{API_URL}}
- Admin: {ADMIN_EMAIL}

## Security policy
- Password transmission: {PASSWORD_TRANSMISSION}
- Min length: {MIN_LENGTH}
- Requirements: {REQUIREMENTS}
- MFA: {MFA_STATUS}
- Breached-password check: {BREACHED_CHECK_STATUS}

## Test accounts
| Account | Password | Role |
|---|---|---|
| {TEST1_EMAIL} | {TEST1_PASSWORD} | test user 1 |
| {TEST2_EMAIL} | {TEST2_PASSWORD} | test user 2 |
| {TEST3_EMAIL} | {TEST3_PASSWORD} | test user 3 |

> Test passwords are shown once; reset them in the admin portal afterwards.

## Portals
| Portal | Address | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Admin | {{PORTAL_ADMIN}} | users / roles / security policy / audit log |
| User | {{PORTAL_USER}} | change password / devices / MFA |
| Security | {{PORTAL_SECURITY}} | anomaly detection / login trends |
| Developer | {{PORTAL_DEVELOPER}} | API docs / OAuth clients / app settings |
| Status | {{PORTAL_STATUS}} | service health |

## Reminders
1. Admin password stored separately (not in this file)
2. .env.local is gitignored
3. Check the developer portal after upgrades for new security features
```
<!-- /lang:en -->
<!-- lang:zh -->
## AUTIONAL_SETUP.md 模板

```markdown
# Autional 接入配置 — {PROJECT_NAME}

## 基本信息
- 接入日期: {DATE}
- 框架: {FRAMEWORK}
- 租户: {TENANT_NAME}
- Region: .{{REGION}}
- 环境: {ENVIRONMENT}

## 配置信息
- App ID: {APP_ID}
- Issuer: {{ISSUER}}
- API URL: {{API_URL}}
- 管理员: {ADMIN_EMAIL}

## 安全策略
- 密码传输: {PASSWORD_TRANSMISSION}
- 最小长度: {MIN_LENGTH}
- 要求: {REQUIREMENTS}
- MFA: {MFA_STATUS}
- 泄露密码检查: {BREACHED_CHECK_STATUS}

## 测试账号
| 账号 | 密码 | 角色 |
|---|---|---|
| {TEST1_EMAIL} | {TEST1_PASSWORD} | 测试用户 1 |
| {TEST2_EMAIL} | {TEST2_PASSWORD} | 测试用户 2 |
| {TEST3_EMAIL} | {TEST3_PASSWORD} | 测试用户 3 |

> 测试密码仅显示一次；后续可在管理后台重置。

## 门户
| Portal | 地址 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| 管理后台 | {{PORTAL_ADMIN}} | 用户/角色/安全策略/审计日志 |
| 用户门户 | {{PORTAL_USER}} | 修改密码/设备/MFA |
| 安全仪表盘 | {{PORTAL_SECURITY}} | 异常检测/登录趋势 |
| 开发者门户 | {{PORTAL_DEVELOPER}} | API 文档/OAuth 客户端/应用设置 |
| 系统状态 | {{PORTAL_STATUS}} | 服务运行状况 |

## 提醒
1. 管理员密码单独保存（不在此文件）
2. .env.local 已 gitignore
3. 升级后到开发者门户查看新增安全能力
```
